words.word: and it shall be a ruinous

occurrences.text: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
words: and it shall be a ruinous

occurrences.text: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
